name: Mid-senior candidate opens with respected ma'am / it's an honour framing
notes: v5.3 realism: over_deferential_opener — services-coded register depresses comp anchor at MNC / FAANG / GCC HR rounds.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Respected ma'am, first of all, thank you so much for this opportunity — it's an honour to be considered for this role. I am a senior backend engineer with 9 years of experience across Flipkart and Razorpay, currently leading the payouts squad.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why are you considering a switch?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Looking for a fresh problem space — payouts has plateaued for me.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 60 days notice, buyout possible at one month gross with a handover plan.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about a project you owned end to end.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Designed and shipped the new instant payouts pipeline handling 5M transactions a day. Owned spec to launch over five months.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: ₹48 LPA fixed, ₹6 LPA variable (paid out at ~85% historically), ₹4 LPA joining bonus, RSU vest of ₹25 LPA over 4 years with a 1-year cliff.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Your founder's blog on ledger consensus lines up with my interests, and the engineering scale you're at is the next jump from where I am.
